def solve(case):
    if not isinstance(case, dict):
        raise ValueError("case must be dict")
    payload = case.get("payload")
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("payload missing or invalid")
    threshold = payload.get("threshold")
    if not isinstance(threshold, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("threshold missing or not numeric")
    calls = payload.get("calls")
    if not isinstance(calls, list):
        raise ValueError("calls missing or not list")
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        if not isinstance(call, dict):
            raise ValueError("call must be dict")
        call_id = call.get("call_id")
        loss_without = call.get("loss_without_call")
        loss_with = call.get("loss_with_call")
        pred_tokens = call.get("prediction_tokens")
        parseable = call.get("parseable")
        if None in (call_id, loss_without, loss_with, pred_tokens, parseable):
            raise ValueError("missing fields in call")
        if not isinstance(call_id, str):
            raise ValueError("call_id must be string")
        if not isinstance(loss_without, (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("loss_without_call must be numeric")
        if not isinstance(loss_with, (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("loss_with_call must be numeric")
        if not isinstance(pred_tokens, int) or pred_tokens < 1:
            raise ValueError("prediction_tokens must be positive integer")
        if not isinstance(parseable, bool):
            raise ValueError("parseable must be boolean")
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        norm_gain = gain / pred_tokens
        if parseable and norm_gain >= threshold:
            accepted.append(call_id)
            diagnostics.append({
                "call_id": call_id,
                "gain": round(gain, 6),
                "normalized_gain": round(norm_gain, 6)
            })
    return {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }
